pilot: 北門—台北車站，含承德市民天橋及地下街介面

planar_baseline.role: 原先二維研究提案，非已確定的A組引擎；主A/B必須共用同一可處理層級連接的引擎

multilevel.connection_rule: explicit verified physical access only; no XY intersection auto-connection
multilevel.layer_identity_rule: station-scoped floor IDs; join only with documented connectors; no constant floor-height assumption
multilevel.engine_verification: not found in PATH or /Applications; no engine installed or executed this audit

release_gates: 核實入口坐標與地面合法穿越
逐段核對上下層端點、閘門與時段
記錄高程或明示只做拓撲
稽核斷線、重複線及立體誤接
確認工具版本、三維角度定義及小型已知網絡驗證

comparison.B_additions_only: verified publicly traversable bridges, underground paths and their connectors
comparison.unknown_links: exclude from confirmed B, list as unknown; do not infer physical disconnection
outputs: A and B side-by-side with shared colour scale
B minus A change for the same north-south OD pairs
route distance and detour where verified geometry exists
comparison.conditional_B: state time window and access assumptions; no unverified all-day availability
comparison.centrality_caution: 新增路網改變節點集合與標準化分母；固定地面OD的連通／距離差為直接比較，不能將不同引擎的NAIN/NACH相減

Y_mall_hours.other_operators: retain separately documented restrictions; do not override with mall hours

A1_east_connection.destination: 台北車站地下公共通道
A1_east_connection.stairs_and_lifts: trace official A1 diagram sources/a1-3d.png; preserve B1M/B1 and paid-area boundary

space_classification.obstacles: retain actual walls, fare gates, voids and other nonwalkable areas

ramp_rule.ratio: absolute vertical difference / horizontal route run
ramp_rule.vertical_connector_warning: do not apply to elevator shafts or stairs explicitly shown by official diagram

walking_connectivity.elevator_role: optional alternative; may reduce walking effort, not assumed faster without waiting/travel time

street_view.use: verify physical endpoints and surface connections
